message.content:
This editorial illustration features the cover of "TEMPO" magazine, dated "EDISI 14-20 MEI 2012". At the top, white text reads "WAWANCARA IRSHAD MANJI", "RAMAI-RAMAI BURON SEBELUM EKSEKUSI", and "LARANGAN EKSPOR MINERAL MENTAH".

The central image is a point-of-view perspective from inside a vehicle, looking through a rounded, oval window. A dark-skinned hand with five fingers extended is pressed against the glass. The hand wears a silver-colored wristwatch with a round black face and a dark strap on the left wrist. Through the window, a landscape of greyish-brown mountainous terrain and a light blue sky with white clouds is visible. The window has a light-grey frame with a sliding shutter handle at the top. 

Large, bold black text in the bottom right corner reads "ASTAGA SUKHOI". The bottom left contains a price of "RP 29.700", website "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and a barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00011". The entire composition is framed by a solid red vertical bar on the left and a red horizontal bar at the bottom. The background is a dark grey gradient.
